summary: Prompt 17 E2E validation on live preview backend (https://hogo-backend-phase1.preview.emergentagent.com) + Expo web frontend (390x800). BACKEND live E2E via /app/backend/tests/live_prompt17_api.py = 17/17 PASSED (~175s). FRONTEND Expo web: language→phone→OTP→home flow works for CGM (9000000500) and lands on /home with home-tile-announce + home-tile-employees visible. Announce screen for CGM renders 'All employees' chip (audience=all, [data-testid=announce-audience-all]) AND all 11 department chips (announce-dept-{CODE}) — verified for PRODUCTION, ADMIN, ENGINEERING, TIME_OFFICE etc. Fill+send flow completes: title/message inputs accept input, 'Production' selected, [data-testid=announce-send-button] clicked, spinner shown (eye loader inside button), no error toast. Employees screen loads, add-employee-button opens /employees/new with emp-id-input prefilled from /api/admin/emp-id-suggest (observed values 1216 → 1217, monotonically increasing). Edit navigation confirmed: tapping employee-row navigates to /employees/edit and mounts [data-testid=edit-employee-screen] with prefilled emp-name-input.

integration_issues.issue: When rapidly changing the search query (e.g. 'Demo' → clear → 'E2E'), stale results from the previous query can render because searchEmployees() promises race and later-arriving stale response overwrites current results. Repro: type 'Demo' (0 rows appear because debounce hasn't fired yet), clear, type 'E2E' → UI shows 10 'Demo *' rows even though the input reads 'E2E'. Fix: cancel in-flight request when query changes or attach a request-id and only apply the latest. Reference: /app/frontend/app/employees/index.tsx L32–L50.

After a successful CGM announcement send the code calls router.back() but on Expo web the browser URL remained /announce and the form was reset to defaults instead of returning to /home. Not blocking (send succeeded, no error toast), but the UX contract of returning to Home after send is broken on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/announce.tsx L66–L67.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'useNativeDriver is not supported' on Expo web on multiple screens. Cosmetic, no functional impact.

action_items: Fix employees/index.tsx: guard against stale searchEmployees() responses (attach request-id / AbortController) so switching queries doesn't render prior results.

Fix announce.tsx web navigation: on web, router.back() from the announce screen leaves the browser on /announce with a reset form instead of returning to /home. Consider router.replace('/home') on send success or explicit router.push back to previous route.

OPTIONAL: EmployeeForm phone-input is hard to drive via Playwright's keyboard.type because RN Web TextInput doesn't reliably capture the '+' character via synthetic key events, so end-to-end automation of new-employee creation via UI is currently flaky. Consider allowing the input to auto-prepend '+91' when the user types 10 digits (like the login screen already does with [data-testid=phone-input]). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/EmployeeForm.tsx L100–L109 (regex L23).
OPTIONAL (untestable): Push token registration and CaptureGuards checklist are native-only by design; face-enroll page redirect is also native-only — per the handoff note these are NOT bugs on web.

Manager-side EscalateModal UI, worker-side Alerts tab announcement rendering, and worker regression tiles were NOT exercised in this iteration (time-boxed); backend flows for escalation + announcement dispatch are already 17/17 green so they're low-risk. Recommend a follow-up UI-only pass focused on: login 9000000101 → open assigned incident → EscalateModal (mode chips, dept list, person search, reason input) → submit → status=escalated; and login 9000000001 → Alerts tab shows 📢 announcement.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/employees/index.tsx — debounced search but does NOT cancel in-flight requests when query changes; visible race demonstrated live.

/app/frontend/src/components/EmployeeForm.tsx L23 PHONE_REGEX=/^\+91[6-9]\d{9}$/ and L100 TextInput onChangeText strips non-[\d+], but does not auto-prepend +91, making the field awkward to fill. Login screen already handles this well — worth harmonizing.
/app/frontend/app/announce.tsx — post-send router.back() works on native but on Expo web (browser history) it can loop back to /announce; test observed URL /announce after send.

Backend contracts verified against live preview: /api/admin/announcements (dept scoping + all-audience CGM), /api/admin/employees direct-add + role guardrails, /api/admin/employees/{id} PATCH (rename OK for TO, grant Manager 403 for TO, manager-account edit 403 for TO), /api/auth/me role_code refresh on SAME token, /api/incidents/{id}/escalate mode=department/employee + reason<3→422, /api/incidents/escalation-targets role_rank<=3, /api/employees/me/face-enroll idempotency (2nd call 409), GET /api/admin/emp-id-suggest returns {suggested_emp_id: '<next>'} (note: NOT 'emp_id' or 'next_emp_id' — future test writers should align on this exact key).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/live_prompt17_api.py (new, 17 pytest tests hitting live preview URL)

success_rate.frontend: core screens verified; 2 UX bugs found; new-employee submit via UI flaky under automation (unrelated to functionality)

seed_data_creation: Backend live tests created is_demo rows under +91900XXXXXXX bucket (E2E Test Worker, E2E Wannabe Mgr, E2E CGM-created Mgr, E2E Face Enroll etc.). Per handoff note these are auto-cleaned. One live incident on the CGM's open queue was mutated via /api/incidents/{id}/escalate (dept + employee mode) — status is now 'escalated'; note: the test picks the first open demo incident and does not roll back status. That's expected per is_demo isolation policy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For live E2E hitting the preview URL, demo phones ALWAYS accept OTP 123456 via POST /api/auth/verify-otp — skip send-otp entirely (10-min rate limit). Demo phones live in +919000000xxx bucket (worker 001, mgr 101, TO mgr 113, CGM 500) plus fresh direct-added rows go into +919XXXXXXXXX (still is_demo=true because seeded by a demo actor). Emp-id suggest response key = suggested_emp_id (not emp_id or next_emp_id). EmployeeForm PHONE_REGEX is /^\+91[6-9]\d{9}$/ — pass full 13-char value; on RN Web, using page.keyboard.type() to enter '+' into a RN TextInput is unreliable — prefer page.fill() with the FULL string BUT be aware page.fill() does not fire RN Web onChangeText on all builds. Best practice: for RN Web forms, click the input then evaluate to dispatch a synthetic React change event, or (recommended) request main agent to auto-prepend +91 in EmployeeForm so the field takes 10 digits like login. On CGM (9000000500), Announce screen renders All-employees + all 11 dept chips. On TIME_OFFICE mgr (9000000113), only the fixed 'Time Office' chip renders (no dept list) — this is by-design per announce.tsx isTop logic. Race condition in employees/index.tsx debounce → cancel in-flight promise. To reset OTP rate limit (only needed for non-demo phones): `cd /app/backend && python3 -c "import asyncio; from app.redis_client import redis_client; asyncio.run(redis_client.delete('otp:send:+91XXXXXXXXXX'))"`.
rca_of_issue: Two minor frontend bugs identified: (1) employees search race — searchEmployees() promise from a previous query can resolve after a newer one, overwriting results; add AbortController or a request-id guard. (2) Announce navigation on web — router.back() on Expo web from /announce after send left the browser on /announce with the form reset instead of returning to /home; likely because the previous screen in history was also /announce (fresh nav) or because the form re-mounted from an internal navigation. Consider router.replace('/home') on send success. Both are non-blocking and do not affect backend behavior.
